Aniket borrows Rs. 8000 for 2 years at 3.5 percent p.a. simple interest. He immediately lends it to Kavish at 5.25 percent p.a. simple interest for 2
years. What is the gain of Aniket in this transaction?

explanation.standard: Difference in rates = 5.25%−3.5% = 1.75%. Gain for two years = ₹8000×1.75×2/100 = ₹280.
explanation.beginner: This is question #60 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option C.

questionText:
An amount of Rs. 500000 is split into 2 parts and each part is invested in two types of bonds. The first yields an interest of 8 percent p.a. and
second, 12 percent p.a. If the total interest on both the parts at the end of 1 year is 10.5 percent p.a., then what was the amount invested in each
type of bond?

explanation.standard: Let x be in the 8% bond. Then 0.08x+0.12(500000−x)=0.105×500000=52500. Solving gives x=₹187500 and ₹312500 in the 12% bond.
explanation.beginner: This is question #61 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option A.

questionText:
Aashima lent Rs. 10000 to Prakash for 2 years compounded half yearly. At the end of 2 years she got Rs. 20736 from Prakash. Then, what is the
rate of interest p.a.?

explanation.standard: There are four half-years. 20736/10000 = 2.0736 = (1.2)^4, giving 20% per half-year and 40% per annum nominal.
explanation.beginner: This is question #62 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option D.

questionText:
Kanika travelled a distance of 54 Km in 10 hours. She travelled partly on foot at 3 Km/hr and partly by autorickshaw at 15 Km/hr. What is the
distance travelled by autorickshaw?

explanation.standard: Let x km be by auto. Then (54−x)/3 + x/15 = 10. Multiply by 15: 270−5x+x=150; x=30 km.
explanation.beginner: This is question #63 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option C.

questionText:
Sarita goes to visit her client from her house at a speed of 20 Km/hr and returns at a speed of 25 Km/hr. If she takes 9 hours in going and coming,
then what is the distance between her house and her client?

explanation.standard: For one-way distance d: d/20+d/25=9; 9d/100=9, so d=100 km.
explanation.beginner: This is question #64 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option D.

questionText:
The distance between two cities X and Y is 570 Km. A train starts from X at 10 PM and travels towards Y at 110 Km/hr. Another train starts
from Y at 11 PM and travels towards X at 120 Km/hr. At what time will they meet?

explanation.standard: The first train covers 110 km by 11 PM. Remaining distance = 570−110=460 km. Combined approaching speed = 110+120=230 km/h. They meet 460/230=2 hours after 11 PM, at 1 AM.
explanation.beginner: This is question #65 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option B.

provenance.documentReference: DSSSB Junior Assistant 2021 | CBT Mathematics & Reasoning

questionText:
Three men can make a certain number of cloth bags in 8 days by working for 6 hours a day. For how many hours in a day should two men work
in order to make thrice the number of bags in 24 days?

explanation.standard: Bags made ∝ men×days×hours. Triple work needs 3×3×8×6=432 man-hours. Two workers over 24 days must work 432/(2×24)=9 hours daily.
explanation.beginner: This is question #66 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option C.

provenance.documentReference: DSSSB Junior Assistant 2021 | CBT Mathematics & Reasoning

questionText:
Shruti and Rohan undertake a project worth Rs. 88000. Shruti alone can do the work in 10 days. They work together for 4 days. After 4 days,
Rohan works alone for 4 days and Shruti completes the remaining work in 4 more days. What is the share of Rohan in the earnings?

explanation.standard: Shruti works for 4 joint days and 4 final days = 8 days. At 1/10 per day, her contribution is 4/5 of the project, leaving 1/5 for Rohan. Rohan receives ₹88000/5=₹17600.
explanation.beginner: This is question #67 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option D.

provenance.documentReference: DSSSB Junior Assistant 2021 | CBT Mathematics & Reasoning

questionText:
Alok can do a piece of work in 20 days. Biju can do the same work in 40 days and Pramod in 25 days. Alok and Pramod worked for 3 days and
handed it to Biju. Biju worked for some days and handed it again to Alok and Pramod 7 days before completing the work. For how many days
did Biju work?

explanation.standard: Together Alok and Pramod work at 1/20+1/25=9/100 job/day. They work for 3+7=10 days and complete 90% of the job. Biju must do 10% at 1/40 job/day: 0.1×40=4 days.
explanation.beginner: This is question #68 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option D.

provenance.documentReference: DSSSB Junior Assistant 2021 | CBT Mathematics & Reasoning

questionText:
Kapila is two-third as fast as Vipul and Vipul is thrice as fast as Bhupen. If together they can complete a work in 15 days, then in how many days
can Kapila, Vipul and Bhupen each working alone do the work respectively?

explanation.standard: Relative work rates are Kapila:Vipul:Bhupen = 2:3:1. Total 6 units per day corresponds to 1/15 job, so the individual times are 45, 30 and 90 days.
explanation.beginner: This is question #69 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option A.

provenance.documentReference: DSSSB Junior Assistant 2021 | CBT Mathematics & Reasoning

questionText: If the surface area of a sphere is 1386 sq cm, then what is the volume of that sphere?

explanation.standard: Surface area = 4πr² = 1386. Using π = 22/7 gives r = 10.5 cm. Volume = 4πr³/3 = 4851 cm³.
explanation.beginner: This is question #70 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option B.

provenance.documentReference: DSSSB Junior Assistant 2021 | CBT Mathematics & Reasoning

questionText: If the volume of a cone is 254.34 cu cm and height is 12 cm, then what is the base diameter of the cone?

explanation.standard: Cone volume V = πr²h/3. With V=254.34 and h=12, r²=20.25, r=4.5 and diameter=9 cm.
explanation.beginner: This is question #71 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option C.

provenance.documentReference: DSSSB Junior Assistant 2021 | CBT Mathematics & Reasoning

questionText:
A hollow cylindrical pipe is made of cement. The volume of cement used in the pipe is 3696 cu m. It's external radius is 10 m and length is 14 m.
What is the thickness of the pipe?

explanation.standard: Cement volume = πh(R²−r²). Thus 3696=(22/7)×14×(100−r²); r²=16 and internal r=4. Thickness = 10−4=6 m.
explanation.beginner: This is question #72 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option B.

provenance.documentReference: DSSSB Junior Assistant 2021 | CBT Mathematics & Reasoning

questionText:
The following pie-chart shows the distribution of students of graduate level in eight different institutes. If the total number of graduate level
students is 23800, then what is the total number of graduate level students in institute W?

explanation.standard: Read institute W’s percentage from the pie chart and multiply it by 23800. The result is 4998.

questionText:
The following table gives the percentage of marks obtained by four students in four different subjects in an examination. What are the average
marks obtained by all the students in chemistry?

explanation.standard: Convert each student’s Chemistry percentage to actual marks using the subject maximum, sum those marks, and divide by four.

questionText:
The following table shows the population proportion of five villages and percent population that are below poverty line. If the population of the
village C is 40000, then what will be the population of village A below poverty line in that year?

explanation.standard: Use village C’s population and its share of the total to recover the overall population, then multiply by A’s share and A’s below-poverty percentage.

questionText:
The bar graph shows the sales of cell phones (in thousands) from four branches of a company during two consecutive years 2018 and 2019. What
is the average sales of all the branches (in thousands) for the year 2018?

explanation.standard: Read the 2018 bar value for each of the four branches, sum them and divide by four. The average is 15 thousand.

questionText:
The following line graph shows the annual percent profit earned by a company during the period 2010-2015. If the expenditures in 2010 and
2015 are equal, then what is the ratio of the income in 2010 and 2015 respectively? [Profit percent = (Income - Expenditure) / Income × 100]

explanation.standard: Use Profit% = (Income−Expenditure)/Income × 100, so Income = Expenditure/(1−Profit%). Since expenditures are equal, compare the denominators for 2010 and 2015.
explanation.beginner: This is question #78 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option C.

provenance.documentReference: DSSSB Junior Assistant 2021 | CBT Mathematics & Reasoning

questionText:
The following line graph shows the exports from three companies from the year 2005 to 2010. Average annual export during the given period for
company B is what percent of the average annual exports for company C?

explanation.standard: Read all annual exports for B and C. Compare their sums or means (the number of years is equal): (sum B / sum C)×100 ≈ 96.63%.
explanation.beginner: This is question #79 from official Junior Assistant (2021 Shift 2). The official correct answer is Option A.

questionText:
The graph shows the foreign exchange reserves of a company (in $ hundred crore) from 2001-2002 to 2010-2011. What is the ratio of the number
of years, in which the foreign exchange reserves are above the average reserves, to those in which the reserves are below the average reserves?

explanation.standard: Compute the mean reserve over the chart’s years, then count years strictly above and strictly below that mean. They are in a 1:1 ratio.
